title: Capture the Phase-0 benchmark baseline as an immutable record anchored to a commit SHA
spec_anchor: command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json#TST-0302; _USER-PROMPTS.md:10657 (capture benchmark baselines before changing behavior) — file absent on this sparse worktree
question_or_target: Implementation target: spec :10657 requires capturing benchmark baselines before changing behaviour. The Phase-0 ground lane measured that the working tree was mutating under the snapshot and concluded only the commit SHA is a valid rollback anchor. Apply the same discipline here: every baseline record binds to a commit SHA plus the captured environment, is written append-only, and is rejected if the tree was dirty at capture time.

implementation.rule: Metrics are git cat-file at the SHA. Dirty trees are refused unless accept_dirty=True, in which case status=PROVISIONAL is written on the record. A second write of the same baseline_id raises BaselineImmutableError.

evidence.claim: Deliberately dirty tree: default capture raised DirtyTreeRejected; accept_dirty wrote status=PROVISIONAL on the record itself (field_in_record=True). Emitter re-run: default=DirtyTreeRejected provisional=PROVISIONAL.

Second write of baseline_id=phase0 raised BaselineImmutableError; unsafe_overwrite mutated bytes (True). SHA rematerialize via git cat-file stayed inside the B03 variance floor (roundtrip_ok=True, after worktree mutation True); worktree walk left the floor (True). Independent payload digest matched True.

tests.requirement: Dirty-tree capture is rejected or marked PROVISIONAL, proven by capturing against a deliberately dirty tree.
Immutability: a second write to the same baseline id must fail.
Round-trip: the baseline can be re-materialised from the SHA and reproduces the recorded metrics within the B03 variance floor.

negative_controls.description: A mutant that stamps IMMUTABLE on a dirty tree must fire; live capture writes PROVISIONAL.
unsafe_overwrite rewrites an existing baseline_id; live append refuses the second write.
After mutating cases/router.json, git cat-file at the recorded SHA stays inside the B03 floor; a worktree walk does not.
